name: billflow-pro
description: BillFlow Pro - Zoho Books-style billing platform

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: echo 'Backend is already built (Node.js)' && npm install
scripts.build:frontend: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: echo 'Add ESLint to backend when ready'
scripts.lint:frontend: npm run lint --prefix frontend 2>/dev/null || echo 'Frontend linting not configured'
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:frontend: npm run test --prefix frontend 2>/dev/null || echo 'Frontend tests not configured'
